acts: Unicode Standard Annex #14, Unicode Line Breaking Algorithm, revision 57
Unicode Standard Annex #29, Unicode Text Segmentation, revision 49

en.title: UAX #14 rev. 57, Section 5: LB21a is listed among rules that use East_Asian_Width, General_Category and Extended_Pictographic
en.summary: Section 5 lists the rules that use tailorable East_Asian_Width, General_Category and Extended_Pictographic values: LB15a, LB15b, LB19, LB19a, LB21a, LB30 and LB30b. LB21a, “HL (HY | HH) × [^HL]”, uses only line break classes.
en.impact: A reader who tailors these properties looks for an effect on LB21a that does not exist; no break changes.

quotes.text: In addition to the line breaking properties defined in this section, the algorithm defined in Section 6, Line Breaking Algorithm also makes use of East_Asian_Width property values, defined in Unicode Standard Annex #11, East Asian Width [ UAX11 ], as well as the General_Category and Extended_Pictographic properties. Note that for purposes of the line breaking algorithm, those property values are tailorable, as are the rules of the line breaking algorithm which use them. (See rules LB15a, LB15b, LB19, LB19a, LB21a, LB30, and LB30b .)

responsible.role: publishes the annex and the Unicode Character Database

ai_role.en: AI agents read the annexes and the data files and compared them; the examples were run through published implementations. An AI coordinator checked each place against the full annex and the trackers, and two further AI models checked the report before filing.
